source: due2-native: an ordering operator on a concept-scheme operand (decisions/0015 #8; issue #69)
notes: Authored for due2. The policy is valid ODRL 2.2; the rejection is due2's own.

expected_rejection.why: odrl:lt compares an operand that names a concept scheme, and due2 gives concepts only eq, neq, isAnyOf, and isNoneOf. due2-profiles.md §4 rejects any other operator with OperatorTypeMismatch.
